newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston names Swihart as CFO.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston names Swihart as CFO.

text.p: BankBoston Corp said executive vice president Susannah Swihart has been appointed chief financial officer.
Swihart steps into one of the jobs held by current vice chairman and chief financial officer William Shea.

In a statement Thursday, the bank said Shea will be leaving the bank to pursue other interests. The bank said that Shea will stay on and assist the bank through a transition period. He was with BankBoston for five years.
Swihart is a 17 year veteran of the bank, serving the last two years as chief of staff.
BankBoston says it had assets totalling $64.8 billion as of March 31, making it the 15th largest bank holding company in the U.S.
